_note: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (VI): "has income of the nature referred to in section 115BBE" (2017). Its own code, not SPECIAL_CASE_INCOME, because their equivalence with the 2025 Act's Part A of Chapter XIII is unread (W-090d C3a, D-652). The engine computes no such income, so the person answers it. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 only: r.12(1) as in force for AY 2026-27.
question: Do you have any income of the nature referred to in section 115BBE of the Income-tax Act, 1961?

provenance.sourceDescription: egazette 2017/175133, Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2017, S.O. 1006(E), inserting Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso items (IV) – (VI), p.163
